answer: Hold the payment. Grade the work with one panel, then re-queue a fraction for a second panel drawn from different subnetworks. Release escrow only when both panels agree. Disagreement sends the case to a third draw and holds the funds longer. A saffron account that farms answers meets the same double review with no discount for size. Each queued case locks capital, and the hollow identity behind it earns nothing while it waits. The jade moves only after two independent agreements.
